classification.notes: The article is a headline-only SEC exemptive order regarding the treatment of customer margin under Rule 15c3-3 (the Customer Protection Rule). This is a broker-dealer net capital/customer protection regulation. It does not describe an outside market, member stress, infrastructure, or cyber event that maps to any card in the catalog. It is a regulatory action affecting broker-dealer margin accounting treatment, not a Treasury clearing mandate, repo stress, equity selloff, settlement cycle change, member default, or any other Step 1 event covered by the cards.
